g.text: Second-half directional memory across size and input regimes
Discard first half: chemicals t=16000–32000; Spring t=1600–3200. These finite windows are not assumed stationary.
■ original strengths: n=12 seeds ○ new strengths: n=2 seeds Thin whiskers: supported-seed range, not a confidence interval.
Both endpoint R≥0.1. Direction is reported only with ≥100 eligible pairs and ≥1% coverage; × marks unavailable, while coverage remains shown.
Heading is the activity-vector direction, not cell movement. Whole positive input mean and fluctuation amplitude scale together; native laws/clocks differ by model.
Spring uses actual basal circumference for this size axis and actual C(t) in physical activity moments. Connecting segments guide the eye between three sizes.
